testimonials.author: Harsh Pandey
testimonials.testimonial: When we established the club back in 2022, our goal was to bridge the gap between academic theory and coding environment. Reflecting on my year as club lead, I am incredibly proud of the culture of mentorship and events we set in motion. The launch of this website marks a major milestone in the club’s evolution. It serves as a digital portfolio of our growth and a launchpad for the next generation of tech leaders at our college. It is an honour to see the vision we started with continue to thrive so powerfully.

testimonials.author: Bikash Barua
testimonials.testimonial: Being a founding member of CodeMate Club has been a truly rewarding experience. It is inspiring to see how the club has grown into a platform where students can learn, collaborate, and explore new technologies together. I am proud to have contributed to its foundation and look forward to seeing it continue to empower future innovators and developers.

testimonials.author: Asif Ahmed
testimonials.testimonial: A commendable initiative by Code Mate at NEHU, empowering students to strengthen their technological capabilities and industry readiness. It's encouraging to witness an ecosystem where continuous learning, innovation, and hands-on skill development are shaping the next generation of technology professionals.
